_comment: TEMPLATE for the PubChem KEY-MEMBERSHIP estimate (casmi.candidates.pubchem_membership). Obtain the file MANUALLY -- nothing in this repository downloads anything, and URLs are refused. Put it under MyDrive/EnvedaCASMI/data/external/pubchem/ and set `coverage.pubchem_membership.file` in configs/casmi_v2_colab.yaml (the file name is NOT fixed by code). VERIFY the column layout against your file before building.
_layout_default: PubChem's CID-InChI-Key export: tab-separated, gzip-compressed, NO header, three columns CID / InChI / InChIKey. For a CSV/TSV with a header set header=true and name the columns in cid_col / inchikey_col.
_caveat: connectivity_key = first InChIKey block of PubChem's STORED structure. Reported as PUBCHEM_KEY_MEMBERSHIP_ESTIMATE: PubChem's tautomer/charge/salt representation may differ from the competition RDKit tautomer-canonical key.
notes: user-supplied local PubChem CID -> InChIKey file
